A.note: Saturated game-like blue water with a repeating tile pattern. Ships have pink halo markers that look like game pieces. The hill is decent, but the empty sea fills most of the frame.

B.note: Atmospheric haze, darker believable sea, and a rocky hill with red roofs that reads as a real place. Ships are tiny and pale. Most of the frame is empty water, and the sky is flat.

C.note: Almost identical to B, with a slightly clearer town and a less heavy haze. The convoy is still tiny and low-contrast.

D.note: Better sky and sea foam than A, and a more natural water tone. The pink halos around the ships still look like game markers, and the town is hazy and flat.

why: B and C look like a real, hazy Mediterranean harbour. A and D have saturated game-like water and pink-ringed ship markers, so they look like toys.
top_fix_for_best: Make the convoy the subject: move the camera closer or lower, or enlarge and add contrast to the ships (darker hulls, white sails, wakes, gun smoke). Crop out the empty foreground water. Add a warmer sky with cloud and sun-side light so the frame is less washed out.
